- If sentiment is consistently positive (≥0.5) over recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast slightly.
- If sentiment is negative (≤0.2) or volatile, model often underestimates; adjust upward, especially if recent price is trending up.
- Overshoots after sharp spikes (e.g., +5%+ in 1-2 days) are common; cap forecast at 10-15% above peak for next 3-5 days.
- Mean reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above 30d moving avg, reduce by 1-2% per day until convergence.
- For 30d horizon, model often overreacts to short-term sentiment shifts; smooth out 3-5 day moving average before forecasting.
- If sentiment history shows repeated 0.53/0.27 alternation, model tends to overcorrect; dampen forecast by 0.5-1.5% per cycle.
